SELECT CASE WHEN S.DATE_UNKNOWN_IND = 'N' THEN S.FOUND_DATE END AS foundDate, S.FOUND_TIME AS foundTime, S.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, S.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, S.PLACE_NAME AS place, S.CLASS2_CODE AS classification, S.MANPIK_DATE AS manpikDate, S.FIND_A_DATE AS findADate FROM TGMSTR S WHERE S.LIB_ID = #{library} AND S.DEL_IND = 'N'
AND ( (S.DATE_UNKNOWN_IND = 'N' AND S.FOUND_DATE IS NOT NULL AND S.FOUND_DATE >= #{filter.from} AND S.FOUND_DATE <= #{filter.to} )
OR (S.MANPIK_DATE IS NOT NULL AND S.MANPIK_DATE >= #{filter.from} AND S.MANPIK_DATE <= #{filter.to} )
) AND S.CLASS2_CODE = '노방' UNION ALL SELECT S.FOUND_DATE, S.FOUND_TIME, S.ORG_MSTR_CODE, S.ORG_CODE, S.PLACE_NAME, COALESCE(S.CLASS2_CODE, '노방'), NULL, NULL FROM ( SELECT D.FOUND_DATE, D.FOUND_TIME, D.ORG_MSTR_CODE, D.ORG_CODE, D.PLACE_NAME, D.CLASS2_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN D.TGT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('id:', D.TGT_ID) WHEN NULLIF(D.TGT_CODE, '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('code:', D.TGT_CODE) ELSE CONCAT('detail:', D.DAY_DTL_ID) END ORDER BY D.REPORT_DATE, D.DAY_DTL_ID ) AS fallbackOrder FROM DAYDTL D WHERE D.LIB_ID = #{library} AND D.DATE_UNKNOWN_IND = 'N' AND D.FOUND_DATE IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TGMSTR T WHERE T.LIB_ID = D.LIB_ID AND ((D.TGT_ID IS NOT NULL AND T.TGT_ID = D.TGT_ID) OR (D.TGT_ID IS NULL AND NULLIF(D.TGT_CODE, '') IS NOT NULL AND T.TGT_CODE = D.TGT_CODE)) ) ) S WHERE S.fallbackOrder = 1
AND S.FOUND_DATE >= #{filter.from} AND S.FOUND_DATE <= #{filter.to} AND COALESCE(S.CLASS2_CODE, '노방') = '노방'

SELECT S.ACT_DATE AS day, S.START_TIME AS startTime, S.END_TIME AS endTime, S.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, S.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, S.EMPL_ID AS workerId, S.EMPL_CODE AS workerCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(S.EMPL_NAME, ''), P.EMPL_NAME_HAN) AS workerName, P.JOB_CODE AS jobCode, S.PLACE_NAME AS place, S.SESSION_KEY AS sessionKey, S.MEMO AS memo FROM ACTMSTR S LEFT JOIN PSMSTR P ON P.EMPL_ID = S.EMPL_ID AND P.USE_IND = 'Y' AND P.ORG_MSTR_CODE = S.ORG_MSTR_CODE AND P.ORG_CODE = S.ORG_CODE WHERE S.LIB_ID = #{library} AND S.DEL_IND = 'N' AND COALESCE(S.CLASS2_CODE, '노방') = '노방'
AND S.ACT_DATE >= DATE_SUB(#{filter.from}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND S.ACT_DATE <= #{filter.to}
